scope: Synthetic two-role SIL integration slice; not a complete autonomous baseline or gate acceptance.

profile.pose_source: command-integrated SIL dead reckoning with declared error bounds
profile.sensor_coverage: per-beam distinction between return, covered no-return, and uncovered blind beam
profile.supported_motion: forward zero-curvature segments plus stationary ALIGN rotation under 360-degree SIL clearance checks
profile.note: Scenario coordinates, pose initialization, odometry, limits, sensor sampling and timing are synthetic software fixtures; ALIGN clearance checks do not establish physical swept-volume safety, dynamic-obstacle safety, calibration, perception fidelity or competition inputs.

implementation.policy_input: Optional role-scoped PoseEstimate and TopologyGraph; referee truth remains excluded.
implementation.pose_estimator: Deterministic unicycle dead reckoning advances transactionally only after both plant predictions/referee evaluation succeed; position/yaw bounds grow by configured per-distance/per-radian rates.
implementation.topology_binding: TwoRobotMatch binds shared map/topology versions into MatchState and rejects inconsistent graph identities across role endpoints.
implementation.guardian: Selects fixture SEARCH_PORTAL proposals only for versioned, OPEN routes whose pose lies within declared corridor clearance; OptionAuthority admission, replanning generation, CandidateEnvelope/ExecutionLease, pursuit candidate, forward-scan safety and estimated option effect are connected.
implementation.explorer: Supports a no-motion OBSERVE_SAFE option with coverage evidence and OptionAuthority completion; no autonomous route selection or actuation is claimed.
implementation.safety: Uses projected forward clearance, pose-position uncertainty, current estimated signed forward speed, matching timestamp/frame/epochs/versions/option/lease, and the SafetySupervisor. Translation remains zero-curvature; stationary ALIGN requires bounded linear/angular motion, 360-degree covered scan, conservative radial clearance after angular-gap/range/pose/margin deductions, wheel-rate limits, and bounded per-cycle yaw change.
implementation.alignment: Stop-turn-go follows orthogonal path segments by stopping translation, requesting supervised stationary ALIGN rotation, then resuming straight translation. ALIGN parameters are SIL fixtures and are not hardware calibration.
implementation.fault_response: Missing/stale/incoherent pose, scan or topology; excessive pose bounds; insufficient coverage; unsupported routes; invalid execution identity; and safety STOP return zero. Invalid replanning identity revokes and terminates active option authority.
implementation.truth_boundary: PolicyInput contains no referee truth or opponent identity. Synthetic ray hits expose ranges only. Estimated portal effect is not official ARRIVAL and no score is produced.
unsupported: validated opponent detection, tracking, or belief assessor
rival-dependent tactical guards and explorer navigation
curved translation, physical swept-volume safety, dynamic-obstacle safety, or calibrated nonzero-yaw actuation
sensor/odometry fidelity or physical stop/calibration evidence
ROS action server, DDS/process races, MVSim and hardware integration
complete T21/T22/T28-T30 and I11-I14 acceptance matrix

verification.full_regression_command: $env:PYTHONPATH = 'hsl_core;.;ros_ws\src\hsl_safety;ros_ws\src\hsl_interfaces'; python -m pytest hsl_core\tests sim\kinematic ros_ws\src\hsl_interfaces\test ros_ws\src\hsl_safety\test -q
dedicated_cases: two-role policy boundary, Guardian SEARCH_PORTAL effect completion, Explorer OBSERVE_SAFE no-motion completion
shared graph-version binding and stale map/pose/sensor identity rejection
pose-estimate uncertainty, expired match-state lease, negative speed and nonzero yaw rate
uncovered forward scan, unreachable OPEN-route requirement, and nonzero-curvature stop
close-obstacle zero-speed limiting and active lease revocation on invalid replan input
oblique-ray projection for forward stopping clearance
ALIGN rejects missing/partial coverage, insufficient radial clearance, motion while translating, stale or invalid limits, wheel-rate excess, and excessive yaw change
stop-turn-go halts before supervised turn and resumes with straight motion only
